stories.headline: Weymouth continue their unbeaten start to live in the Division One South with a 1-4…
stories.body: Weymouth continue their unbeaten start to live in the Division One South with a 1-4 win over Bristol Manor Farm . They had to come from behind as Corey Evans got Manor Farm in the lead after 14 minutes.
stories.source_title: Dyno-Rod Tuesday Night Round-Up | The Southern League goes goal crazy as ELEVEN goals were scored at Waltham Abbey against Hadley and Melksham Town hit six to move off the bottom of the table
stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.body: Weymouth had their equaliser on 27 minutes through Sam Jackson, before a brace from Toby Holmes, moving his season tally to nine and going first in the top scorer charts in the league in the process, and a fourth goal from Tor Swann t secure their 10th win from 11 league matches.

stories.headline: Hartpury secured an impressive 0-2 away win at fifth place Westbury United last night thanks…
stories.body: Hartpury secured an impressive 0-2 away win at fifth place Westbury United last night thanks to a Kian Davies 32nd minute penalty and Rory Preston’s 89th minute strike to seal the three points, which sees Hartpury move up to ninth.

stories.headline: Our final game saw Melksham Town shock Portland United , and seriously impress with a…
stories.body: Our final game saw Melksham Town shock Portland United , and seriously impress with a 6-0 win. Kitan Jaiyeoba and Dawid Regula both got a brace, with goals from Jake Hicks and Dylan Lewis moving The Town off the bottom and into 20th, with Portland remaining 11th.

stories.body: Alvechurch and Worcester City advanced to the First Round Proper, with Alvechurch beating Spalding United 4-0, and Worcester City beating Chorley 1-0 thanks to an incredible volley by Luke Rowe.
